name: From guard, raise ONLY ONE arm straight overhead with palm u
prompt: From guard, raise ONLY ONE arm straight overhead with palm up; keep the other arm lowered near the waist throughout the charge. Gather a small fiery orb above the single raised palm. It grows into a huge sun, with a round gold-white core, orange roiling surface and sharp radiating solar flares. Hold the sun high overhead and pulse it twice, knees braced. Then bend knees, twist torso, draw that same arm back and whip it forward in one powerful overarm throw toward screen right. The sun leaves the hand, travels right at chest height and bursts near the right edge in a compact solar explosion. Follow through with the throwing arm, then recover to original guard. Fixed feet baseline, stationary camera, entire body visible. Never lift both hands or use a two-handed push. Clear phases: raise, grow, hold, one-handed throw, projectile travel, recovery.
